description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldSingleEnum class, which is responsible for generating an HTML select input for single enum fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It extends another widget class and includes a method 'displayInput' that renders a dropdown based on provided options and application list strings.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldSingleEnum
classes.description: A widget class for rendering dropdowns for single enum fields in the CRM framework.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates HTML for a select dropdown for enum options, optionally removing the blank option based on layout definition.
